basic_info.description: Beautiful detached single-family home tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac in Midtown Terrace, one of San Francisco's most peaceful neighborhoods. Elegant two-story residence with sweeping views of Twin Peaks and Pacific Ocean, ideal for those seeking a peaceful urban retreat. The main level features an open concept living space filled with natural light through sliding doors, with direct access to a sunny deck with fabulous views.The thoughtfully designed kitchen features European-style cabinetry, stainless steel commercial-grade countertops and backsplash, and Viking stainless steel appliances, including a refrigerator, an induction cooktop, a dishwasher, and a double oven.The generously sized primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet with built-in closet organizers. The 2nd bedroom and a full bath complete this level. Enjoy a private, terraced backyard with mature landscaping. Near parks, trails & transit!
